title: THE ROADS NOT TAKEN
subtitle: October 1962 — three options on the ExComm table; Kennedy picked the third.
source: Allison & Zelikow, Essence of Decision (1999); Dobrynin memoirs

actual.label: Naval blockade
actual.outcome: Khrushchev withdraws missiles; secret Jupiter trade in Turkey; Cold War de-escalates briefly into détente phase.

counterfactuals.label: Airstrike on missile sites
counterfactuals.outcome: Soviet tactical nukes (since revealed to have been deployed) likely fire on US forces; rapid escalation to general nuclear exchange.

counterfactuals.label: Full invasion of Cuba
counterfactuals.outcome: Worst case: Soviet tactical nuclear use + Castro's stand-and-fight order = near-certain nuclear war.
counterfactuals.plausibility: Marginal — would have required congressional cover

caption: Each counterfactual passes the Hawthorn plausibility test: based on documented ExComm deliberations and post-1991 Soviet archive disclosures, both alternatives were real possibilities, not idle speculation.
